title: The merge tool's ready check runs a child repo's harness against the claude-settings commit that child pins
why: Coordinator 15:13 CST Nov 8, from runner 9. Incident: the ready check ran q_max's harness against the local claude-settings checkout, not q_max's pinned commit. A skill bump on claude-settings main (map format 6) blocked every q_max batch before q_max's pin moved. Fix: run the ready check against the pinned commit, or name the pin-move PR as the remedy. Red case: a child pinned behind a main skill bump passes its ready check.
